core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghadir corresponds to the Arabic form غدير (Arabic root غ د ر (gh-d-r)). Its core sense is small stream, brook. Ghadir (غدير) is the same Arabic word as Ghadeer — 'small stream, brook, pool' — and a feminine given name. The source gloss 'place of radiance' is unsupported (it appears to be a confusion with نور/ضياء) and has been replaced.

Yes — the underlying form غدير is Arabic.

faq.q: What does Ghadir mean in Persian?

faq.a: Romanization variants include Ghadir, ghadir. Script forms are غدير, غدیر, ग़दीर.

faq.q: Is Ghadir a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
